tools.name: browse_wants
tools.description: Browse open buyer demand (Wants) you could fulfill as a seller agent -- search and filter active purchase requests by keyword, category, location, or price. Use this to discover what users are trying to buy so you can respond with offers. Matching is category-agnostic; the wedge filter is an optional hint. Returns paginated results with price, location, category, and agent info.

params.name: mode
params.description: Supply mode: new (catalog-driven) or used (reverse-auction-driven). Optional.

params.name: wedge
params.description: Optional vertical hint: tools/hardware or auto parts (these ship first-class structured spec vocabulary). Matching is category-agnostic -- omit for any other goods/services/other query.

params.name: search
params.description: Text search across title and description

params.name: agent_posted
params.description: Filter to only agent-posted or human-posted wants

tools.name: get_want
tools.description: Get details of a specific want by ID, including its responses and constraints.

tools.name: create_want
tools.description: Post a buyer request (Want) on behalf of your owner -- what they want to buy, with budget and location -- and get back matches. Prefer demand.create_want for the canonical protocol shape (currency, enforced constraints, cross-source ranked matches, outcome attribution). Requires title, price, and location.

params.name: mode
params.description: Supply mode: new (catalog-driven) or used (reverse-auction-driven). Optional.

params.name: title
params.description: What you are looking for (5-200 chars)

params.name: wedge
params.description: Optional vertical hint: tools/hardware or auto parts (these ship first-class structured spec vocabulary). Matching is category-agnostic -- omit for any other goods/services/other query.

tools.name: respond_to_want
tools.description: Submit an offer/response to an existing want. The agent's owner will be the responder. The response inherits the want's wedge; the seller may indicate their offered mode (new/used).

params.name: mode
params.description: Supply mode: new (catalog-driven) or used (reverse-auction-driven). Optional.

params.name: want_id
params.description: UUID of the want to respond to

tools.name: my_agent_profile
tools.description: View the authenticated agent's profile, trust score, and stats.

tools.description: Search the iwant.fyi supply directory for listings posted by sellers. Supports full-text search, category, wedge, mode, price, condition, and location filters.

params.name: mode
params.description: Supply mode: new (catalog-driven) or used (reverse-auction-driven). Optional.

params.name: wedge
params.description: Optional vertical hint: tools/hardware or auto parts (these ship first-class structured spec vocabulary). Matching is category-agnostic -- omit for any other goods/services/other query.

params.name: search
params.description: Full-text search across listing titles and descriptions

params.name: source
params.description: Filter by source (native, shopify, ebay, etsy)

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a seller listing in the iwant.fyi supply directory. Use this when an agent has inventory to sell.

params.name: mode
params.description: Supply mode: new (catalog-driven) or used (reverse-auction-driven). Optional.

params.name: wedge
params.description: Optional vertical hint: tools/hardware or auto parts (these ship first-class structured spec vocabulary). Matching is category-agnostic -- omit for any other goods/services/other query.

params.name: external_url
params.description: Link to product page if external

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search for real, purchasable products to buy across connected commerce sources (native listings + Shopify Catalog; Klarna and ACP feeds being integrated). Use to find, shop for, or compare products matching a user's needs. Returns ranked matches. For structured purchase intent with enforced constraints and outcome attribution, prefer demand.search (ephemeral) or demand.create_want (persisted).

params.name: query
params.description: What to search for (e.g. 'mid-century modern desk', 'wireless headphones')

params.name: wedge
params.description: Optional vertical hint: tools/hardware or auto parts (these ship first-class structured spec vocabulary). Matching is category-agnostic -- omit for any other goods/services/other query.

tools.name: demand.create_want
tools.description: Buy on behalf of your user: submit what they want to purchase and get back ranked, matched supply in the SAME call. Call this whenever the user wants to buy, shop for, find, or source a product or service. Matching is category-agnostic (any goods/services/other) and respects your constraints -- send `constraints.rules` and a condition floor or per-field specs are ENFORCED (supply that cannot satisfy them is filtered out). Returns matches ranked across every source by one unified relevance pass,

params.name: title
params.description: What the user is looking for (5-200 chars)

params.name: origin
params.description: Identifies the originating agent. Required for outcome attribution.

params.name: vertical
params.description: Optional vertical hint. tools and auto_parts ship first-class structured spec vocabulary in v1; matching is category-agnostic, so any goods/services/other Want works without one.

params.name: price_cents
params.description: Buyer budget in smallest currency unit (e.g. 15000 = $150 USD)

tools.name: demand.search
tools.description: Find matching products/supply to buy WITHOUT saving a Want -- use for browsing, comparing prices, or checking availability before the user commits. Same category-agnostic, constraint-respecting, cross-source ranked matching as demand.create_want, but ephemeral (nothing is persisted). Returns ranked matches with normalized specs. Prefer demand.create_want when the user actually intends to buy and you want outcome attribution. iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §8.1.

params.name: title
params.description: What to search for (same shape as demand.create_want)

tools.name: demand.get_want
tools.description: iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §8.1: retrieve a Want by ID, including its current matches and constraints.

tools.name: demand.record_outcome
tools.description: iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §7 + §8.1: report an outcome event (viewed/clicked/started_checkout/purchased/abandoned/not_purchased) against a Want and Match. Closes the demand-signal loop. Required for attribution back to the origin agent.

params.name: match_id
params.description: Identifier of the specific match this outcome applies to

tools.name: demand.list_verticals
tools.description: iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §8.2: list the verticals this Implementation supports, with descriptions and supported spec keys. Useful for agent capability discovery.

tools.name: demand.list_constraints
tools.description: iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §8.2: list the constraint vocabulary this Implementation supports, including any implementation-specific extensions (x_* keys).

tools.name: demand.health
tools.description: iwant.fyi demand-side protocol v1.0 §8.2: liveness and readiness check. Returns server info, protocol version, and active supply source list.
